rationale: COGT has already gapped up 3.52% and run from $29.10 to a high of $35.13 today on 4.83x relative volume, and price is now pulling back from that high at 74.4% of the day's range with the last few 1-minute candles showing a modest bounce attempt but still well below the 9-EMA ($33.63). The stock is extended far from its prior close with no clear consolidation base to define a low-risk entry in either direction — a long risks chasing a move that has already largely played out, while a short faces the risk of resuming the strong upward momentum with 117 minutes remaining. The spread and liquidity are acceptable, but the risk/reward setup lacks a well-defined structural level to anchor a stop without excessive exposure.
